title: Preliminary agreements and reservations of a signed writing
shortTitle: Preliminary agreements and reservations of a signed wr…
summary: A contemplated formal document may be a condition of commitment or simply a later record of an already concluded agreement.
notes: The notes discuss expressed reservations, partial performance, whether terms are settled, and whether the type of agreement ordinarily receives a signed writing. Letters of intent can disclaim ultimate liability yet create a commitment to a negotiating process. The two preliminary-agreement types discussed by the editors separate a fully settled bargain awaiting form from an obligation to negotiate remaining terms in good faith within a framework. The full class 10 opinions are outside this update.
